editor.blockzone.title: Poison world editor
editor.blockzone.invalid: Enter finite numbers; radius, time and damage must be nonnegative.

setting.battlezone.teamPlayerLimit.desc: Maximum players in each regular team; changes update team capacity.
setting.battlezone.totalPlayerLimit.desc: Maximum players allowed in this map; used to create teams and limit entry.
setting.battlezone.minimumTeamsToStart.d: Minimum occupied teams needed to satisfy the normal match start requirements.
setting.battlezone.countdownSeconds.desc: Delay after the normal start requirements are met, in seconds.
setting.battlezone.deploymentSeconds.des: Minimum deployment duration; deployment also waits for the flight route to finish. The initial circle exists immediately; transitions start after deployment ends.
setting.battlezone.settlementSeconds.des: Delay after the result is shown and before the map resets, in seconds.
setting.battlezone.deploymentSpeed.desc: Horizontal flight speed, between 0.1 and 100 blocks per second.
setting.battlezone.deploymentHeight.desc: Absolute Y coordinate for the flight route. Accepts finite values; keep clear of terrain and buildings.
setting.battlezone.poisonDamagePerSecond: Outside damage per second equals base damage times the current circle multiplier. Two health points equal one heart; zero disables damage.
setting.battlezone.poisonSequences.desc: A complete path is randomly selected each match. The initial circle is used for deployment; later circles may shrink or expand. Use settings sequence edit for world editing.
setting.battlezone.boundaryTexture.desc: Texture resource path for the boundary warning fence, e.g. blockzone:textures/effect/battlezone_warning_fence.png.
setting.battlezone.poisonCircle.x.desc: Configured horizontal X. Out-of-bounds values are retained while the runtime center is translated inside the map.
setting.battlezone.poisonCircle.z.desc: Configured horizontal Z. Out-of-bounds values are retained while the runtime center is translated inside the map.
setting.battlezone.poisonCircle.radius.d: Sphere radius in blocks. Zero and expansion are allowed; the diameter must fit within the horizontal map bounds.
setting.battlezone.poisonCircle.waitSeco: Wait before transitioning to this circle. The initial circle uses deployment time and ignores this field.
setting.battlezone.poisonCircle.shrinkSe: Time to move and shrink or expand from the previous circle. Zero means instant arrival. Not used for the initial circle.
setting.battlezone.poisonCircle.damageMu: Multiplies base poison damage after reaching this circle. During transition the previous circle multiplier applies; zero disables damage.
